generalCriterionList.description: Single entity or Joint venture(maximum 2 members) is acceptable

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should quote exclusive of GST
Tenderer are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
Should comply all the conditions as per the tender document

Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)

3.2(b) Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as UGD project /STP project/ water supply project/ Irrigation Projects /combined water supply & sewerage project/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Road/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Layout works/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Buildings value not less than Rs. 1.63 Crores. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement.

3.2(c) Executed in any one year of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) the following minimum quantities of works. (1) Earthwork excavation in all kinds of soil by mechanical / manual means -1832 Cum (2) Cement concrete (Including RCC & PCC) -822 Cum (3) TMT Steel - 41 Ton. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement in the same financial year. Note: The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement in the same financial year

3.2(d) The tenderer or his identified subcontractor should possess experience in Construction of 1 Nos of SBR/FAL/HAAF/CAMUS/NEBR/equivalent/any other type STP/ WTP works with a minimum of 1.25 MLD Capacity. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: (1) The Experience certificate from the competent Govt /Semi Govt. /Public sector undertaking shall be furnished. The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking. (2) Turnover and the value of completed work shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited. (3) Value of the work mentioned in the work done certificate shall be Excluding GST (4) If the bidder has submitted work done certificate in JV, only JV share will be considered for evaluation purpose. (5) The sub-contractor should provide his consent for associating with the bidder for this tender package. (6) The subcontractor should also provide his experience certificate/ documents for the claimed works

3.3 (a) availability by owning at least 50% of the required/specified key and critical equipment for this work and (b) the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease /hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.) for availability for this work are furnished. (1) Excavators -Total-1 Nos. (Owned -1 No. and Hired -0 No.) (2) Tippers- Total-2 Nos. (Owned -1 No. and Hired -1 No.) (3) Self-loading Concrete mixer -Total-2 Nos. (Owned -1 No. and Hired -1 No.) If the bid is submitted as joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement. Note: The bidder shall provide invoice / RC book copies for owned vehicles and for lease / hire vehicles, agreement along with RC book/ invoice copy for vehicles

3.3(b) Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 1.08 Crore (credit lines/letter of credit/Certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in the peak construction period) in the form of unconditional credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificate from any Nationalized Banks/ Scheduled Banks from Karnataka -India as per the prescribed format. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: Liquid assets in the form of credit line/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be in the format appended with the bid document. Any conditional Banker Certificate will not be accepted and will lead to disqualification.

3.2(a) Achieved in each of the at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 6.51 Crores (i)Audited profit and loss account statement/ balance sheets certified by the chartered accountant, (ii) Turnover certificate with UDIN and (iii) IT returns filed for the above indicated 5 years is to be uploaded along with the technical bid. If the bid is submitted as JV, then the requirement of minimum financial turnover shall be considered on the basis of combined resources. The lead partner should have an annual financial turnover of not less than 51% of total turnover indicated above in any two financial years during last 5 financial years. All document/certificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (unique document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institute of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid documents. Note: In case of JV, Joint venture partnership deed shall be submitted as per section 10 format for Joint Venture along with the other documents through KPP Portal. (1) Individual - Rs. 6.51 Cr. (2) Joint Venture- Lead Member - Not less than Rs. 3.32 Cr.

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.6 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity means (AxNx1.50 - B) Where A means Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N means Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited B means Value, at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year. Note: (1) The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated completion period, remaining period for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. (2) In case of JV, values of A and B shall be the sum total of the respective figures of all the Partners.

itemList.description: PART A Construction of 2.17 MLD HAAF Technology STP including Electro mechanical works at Siddapura ULB of Uttara kannada District HAAF technology STP at Inlet Sewage parameters to be considered for design As per CPHEEO Standards a) Construction of RCC Bar Screen Chamber, Grit Chamber,Primary settling tank,Anaerobic Baffled Reactor,Aeration Tank, Floating wet land Tank ,Chlorination Tank, as per the drawings and as directed by EIC b) ECOCORD,AERATION SYSTEMS,FLOATING GARDEN,Construction of Admin room with toilet with necessary water supply facility as per drawing provided. c) 11kV express feeder main, metering cubical, complete to proposed STP with allied accessories/works including approvals from ESCOMS. (under self-execution). d) Providing LED Solar street lighting to STP area on PSCC Pole with all necessary accessories and as per direction of EIC of work. e) Stainless steel (SS-316) Manual Coarse Bar screen with flat bar suitable for mounting in channel of pecified size with inclination not more than 45 degree and a movable covered containers complete in all respect as per technical specification and the direction of the Engineer. Manually Raked Coarse Bar Screen with 50 mm clear opening for following PEAK FLOW and upto 3m channel depth f) Flow Meter Electromagnetic Induction Bulk Flow Meters. g) Providing Precast Compond Wall, Construction of un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement inside the STP premises using RMC M-30 grade over granular sub-base and wet mix macadam as per the direction of engineer in charge i)OCEMS along with other connected accessories to monitor inlet and Outlet Sewage parameters namely PH, BOD, COD, TSS, Total phophorous, Total Nitrogen, communication interface enable with RS-485/RS-232/RJ45 ethernet port protocal should be modbus. vendor shoud provide modbus register for SCADA integration etc,. along with Civil work complete. OCEMS for STP Self-Surveillance in Compliance with CPCB Standards Excluding Flow Meter and including device with all accessories complete in all respect for real time data transmission to CPCB & SPCB j) Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of each 25 KWP MNRE approved Grid tied Solar Panels at each STPs with inverter, meter, cable etc. suitable for Rooftop installation as well as Utility Scale Solar Power Projects with 25 years of Linear Generation warranty. Work includes designing of solar panel area and MS frame and foundation on ground/roof of Pump house or CWR, showing arrangement of panel in available space, installation of PV module on MS frame as per approved design and drawings. Mounting structure shall be suitably designed to withstand wind velocity up to 150km/hr. Grid Tie Transformer less inverters, Multiple independent MPPTs, Peak efficiency of greaterthan 98 percentage. Connect up to multiple strings PV arrays, Easy & fast connection, Built-in string-level monitoring, IP65 protection level, Wi-Fi /internet based remote monitoring with 5 years warranty. All cabling up to panel and meter, earthing etc. required accessories . The works includes required steel support structure as per the site conditions and requirements in complete. k) Chlorine Dosing System Chlorinator 200gms/Batch Production capacity 25 gms/hr Total time per Batch 8Hrs. Total volume of chlorine generation 200gms/batch. Salt Required per hr 800gms/batch. Electrical power required 230V, 1phase AC 50Hz. DC power supply unit with Input 230 V AC1 NO FRP Brain water tank 35litrs PP/PVC Chlorine storage tank35 Liters Dosing pump Type of Dosing Automatic Proportionate Dosing Dosing flow rate1to 30 lph Min actuating pressure0.3kg/cm square Max orking pressure 5kg/cm square Inlet/Outlet connections three 4th B.S.P Max Temperature 50degree celcious Dosing externally adjustable0.5-2 percent Chlorine test kit 1 set l)Bore well with minimum 5.0 HP submersible pump set along with necessary electrical accessories as per the directions of EIC.
